//: Type checking without a build step.
This app is deployed as plain files: no bundler, no transpile, no dist/.
A full TypeScript migration of 17,800 working lines would freeze feature
work for weeks and risk regressions in code that is currently passing 488
assertions. checkJs gets most of the benefit at a fraction of the risk —
the compiler reads JSDoc annotations and reports the same class of errors,
while the files that ship stay exactly the files that are written.
noEmit is the point: this never produces output.
